prompt: Ink and watercolor illustration in the style of a fantasy cartographer's sketchbook: thick uneven black India-ink outlines with a dip-pen look, loose wet-in-wet indigo and deep teal washes, granulating pigment, warm ochre touches only for lit windows and lanterns, visible paper grain, wide cinematic panoramic landscape at night.
